description_en: Lists the usage of WAF rules
description_zh: 该接口用于列举WAF规则使用情况
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-waf-usage-of-rules --site-id 1 --instance-id esa-site-b0wdsrlba3nk --phase http_custom --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWafUsageOfRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The WAF instance ID.

If this parameter is left empty, the API returns an empty result. We recommend that you always specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
WAF 实例 ID。

当该参数为空时，API 直接返回空结果，建议始终传入
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The phase in which the WAF rule runs. This parameter is required.

Common values: http_custom, http_ratelimit, http_anti_scan, http_bot, http_managed, http_whitelist, and http_threat_intelligence.

Note: This parameter is required on the server side. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter (400)
parameters.help_zh:
WAF 规则运行阶段，必填。

常用取值：http_custom、http_ratelimit、http_anti_scan、http_bot、http_managed、http_whitelist、http_threat_intelligence 等。

注意：该参数在服务端为强制必填，未指定时 API 返回 InvalidParameter(400)
parameters.name: phase

BatchConfigUsage.description_en: The number of rules or rule sets for the specified phase under instance-level batch configuration
BatchConfigUsage.description_zh: 实例级批量配置下，指定 Phase 的规则/规则集数量

InstanceUsage.description_en: The total number of rules or rule sets for the instance under the specified phase, including both site-level and instance-level rules
InstanceUsage.description_zh: 该实例在指定 Phase 下的规则/规则集总用量（包含站点级与实例级）

Usage.description_en: The number of WAF rules or WAF rule sets that have been used
Usage.description_zh: WAF规则/WAF规则集的已使用量
